result_summary.title: Attribution Engine crashing without failover in LATAM Dev
result_summary.description:
Our Attribution Engine in the development environment (LATAM) is crashing. When the primary instance goes down, the failover mechanism does not trigger, leaving the application unavailable.

This is impacting our dev team (approx. 28 users) who rely on this service for testing. Please check why the failover configuration isn't working as expected when the application crashes.
